content.summary: Accept this exact version as ready for the separate final audits within the contracted ordinary computer-assisted scope. The final changes clarify source identity and a lower-bound hypothesis without changing mathematical inputs. No necessary revision or unresolved major methodological objection remains. This assessment does not authorize publication or certify the whole computation independently.

findings.statement: Shared model construction remains a material assurance boundary.
findings.disposition: Sections 3.1 and 7 retain separate family-map, coefficient, coverage and formal-proof obligations; selected independent controls do not establish every row.

findings.statement: Arbitrary-support reductions and acyclic coverage remain explicit.
findings.disposition: The final scope preserves actual-member guards, proper-trace multiplicities, complete-star selection and the separate rho domains tested in earlier rounds.

findings.statement: The historical and active cap-15 model counts remain reconciled.
findings.disposition: The final map uses 21 models and 2541 cases; the historical 29-model domain included eight P8-intersection-1 models excluded upstream.

findings.statement: The identifier relationship is clarified; historical H27 execution remains unauthenticated locally.
findings.disposition: The preserved response supports commit versus tree identification. It neither explains the earlier inconsistent response nor supplies the missing full-ledger replay.

revisions.action: Reassessed final assurance language against prior bounded controls.
revisions.result: No stronger independence or Lean claim introduced.

revisions.action: Rechecked global guards and the direct A3 interface.
revisions.result: The inspected implication order remains sound.

revisions.action: Compared final cap-15 domain wording with the committed resolution.
Compared preserved commit metadata with my earlier tree reconstruction.
revisions.result: Identifier relationship supported; source-to-run limitation retained.

checks.method: Parsed checks/round09/citation_verifier/h27-commit-response.json and compared its commit.tree.sha with checks/round06/methodologist/tree-scope.json and manuscript Section 2.
checks.observation: The returned commit d4d5723267c662291efdadfa6e7061d919e76fa9 names tree 0a3e3838650fc981133940e798c9d220140e785e, exactly my earlier reconstructed root. The manuscript correctly confines the inconsistency to the earlier response and retains absent historical-run authentication. No new network retrieval or ledger execution was performed.

checks.method: Read the final manuscript, GLOBAL67-dependency-roadmap.md, PRIOR_DELTA18_UNLOCK.md and pinned paper/main.tex:968–1028.
checks.observation: For every actual R, the disjoint class is intersecting, so H27 gives |N[R]|>=68-27=41. The prior crowding and cross-star arguments use mu>=41 with Delta<=18; their actual-centre and tail-support guards remain necessary. Sections 4 and 7 activate that package only after D20 and D19. The new conclusion wording neither assumes mu=41 nor imports the old mu42 exclusions.

checks.method: Re-read LOW15-direct-Jin-A3-addon.md and manuscript Section 6; reused the successful round-eight coefficient-identity control.
checks.observation: Jin strictness is 275>272. Independent neighbour preimages give b_i<=27 even for empty fibres; the cyclic identity first gives a_i>=1. Only afterward does an actual vertex imply b_i>=25. Thus the finite r_i domain follows without assuming surjectivity or a complete blowup. No unchanged computational suite was rerun.

checks.method: Inspected actual submissions in prior-committed-history.json, the author response, and the complete final-version diff.
checks.observation: All 13 required revision IDs across nine committed rounds have explicit original-reviewer resolutions; latest submissions contain no open major or critical finding. My nine earlier responses required no revisions. Final Sections 3, 5 and 7 preserve the repaired quantifiers, maximum-degree root choice and assurance limits. The history contains 108 submissions and no final audits; readiness here is therefore acceptance for those separate audits, not evidence that they already occurred.
